preconditions.description: Number of participants and top results are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= point <= 2 * m for point in top_points)
preconditions.description: Each top point is non-negative and does not exceed twice the number of participants.
Top points are provided in non-ascending order.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is either 'yes' or 'no'.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'yes' if any_valid_tournament_exists(m, n, top_points) else return_value[0] == 'no'
postconditions.description: The output correctly indicates whether a valid tournament exists.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == m + 1 if return_value[0] == 'yes' else len(return_value) == 1
postconditions.description: If a valid tournament exists, the output contains m+1 lines; otherwise, it contains only one line.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in return_value[1:]) if return_value[0] == 'yes'
postconditions.description: Each line representing the tournament result has exactly m characters.

postconditions.expression: all(char in 'XWDL' for char in ''.join(return_value[1:])) if return_value[0] == 'yes'
postconditions.description: Each character in the tournament result is one of 'X', 'W', 'D', or 'L'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i][i] == 'X' for i in range(m)) if return_value[0] == 'yes'
postconditions.description: The main diagonal of the tournament result contains 'X'.
